english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for meaning ‘for a long time’.
Use this instead of 好遠 when the great distance is in time rather than space.
Use this for a very long wait or duration, especially when “forever” is hyperbole.

examples.english: I've been waiting for you for a long time.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 hou2 noi6 laa3

examples.english: It’s been far too long since I last saw you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 nei5 laa3

examples.english: You have been waiting for me forever.
examples.jyutping: nei5 dang2 zo2 ngo5 hou2 noi6 laa3
